items.t: Western Union and Supermarket Chain Hy-Vee Extend More Than 30-Year Partnership
items.sum: DENVER, November 17, 2026--Western Union today announced the renewal of its longstanding relationship with Hy-Vee, one of the Midwest's leading supermarket chains, extending a collaboration that has provided customers with convenient access to essential financial services for more than three decades.
